research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: HeyCharge is researching systems for authenticating users at charging devices and reporting usage, as described in 'System for authenticating a user at and reporting about use of a charging device.' The abstract details an authenticating and reporting system utilizing a database unit and cryptography module to sign or encrypt authentication, aligning with their focus on charging infrastructure and payment systems. Their R&D centers on secure user authentication and usage reporting for electric vehicle charging.

about_short_description.short_description: HeyCharge provides charging infrastructure, payment systems, and installation for electric vehicles.

product.name: SecureCharge Module (SCM)
product.description: A hardware module that integrates into existing EV chargers to enable offline authentication and billing without requiring an internet connection.

product.name: HeyCharge Software Development Kit (SDK)
product.description: A software toolkit for integrating HeyCharge features into custom mobile applications on Android and iOS platforms.

product.name: HeyCharge Application Programming Interface (API)
product.description: An API that enables full integration of HeyCharge’s charging platform with backend and IT systems for management and billing.

product.name: Integrated Load Management
product.description: A feature that optimizes power distribution among multiple EV chargers within a building to prevent exceeding power capacity limits.

product.name: HeyCharge Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for users to access and control HeyCharge-enabled EV chargers without RFID cards, supporting offline operation.
